name: Virginia

jury_list.statute: No section of Va. Code title 8.01, chapter 11 (Juries) opens or closes records of persons disqualified as non-citizens. 8.01-337: 'All citizens over 18 years of age who have been residents of the Commonwealth one year, and of the county, city, or town in which they reside six months next preceding their being summoned to serve as such, and competent in other respects, except as hereinafter provided, shall be liable to serve as jurors.' 8.01-353(A) gives counsel of record a copy of the panel with 'name, age, address, occupation, and employer'. Status: null.

sources.cite: Va. Code 8.01-353(A) (copy of the jury panel to counsel of record only)
Va. Code 24.2-427 (cancellation after non-citizen report; notice and 14 days)

voter_file.who_may_get: Not a private citizen. Lists go only to candidates, party committees, PACs, incumbents, voter-participation nonprofits, tax officials, and courts for jury selection (Va. Code 24.2-405(A)). 'The lists shall be furnished to no one else and used for no other purpose.'
voter_file.permitted_uses: Only the purposes listed in 24.2-405 and 24.2-406.
voter_file.use_restriction: Va. Code 24.2-405(A): 'The Department of Elections shall provide, at a reasonable price, lists of registered voters for their districts to (i) candidates for election or political party nomination to further their candidacy, (ii) political party committees or officials thereof for political purposes only, (iii) political action committees that have filed a current statement of organization with the Department of Elections pursuant to § 24.2-949.2, or with the Federal Elections Commission pursuant to federal law, for political purposes only, (iv) incumbent officeholders to report to their constituents, (v) nonprofit organizations that promote voter participation and registration for that purpose only, and (vi) commissioners of the revenue, as defined in § 58.1-3100, and treasurers, as defined in § 58.1-3123, for tax assessment, collection, and enforcement purposes.' 24.2-405(A): 'The lists shall be furnished to no one else and used for no other purpose.'
voter_file.penalty: False statement on the required purchaser statement is a felony (Va. Code 24.2-407, citing 24.2-1016).
voter_file.attestation_required: Signed statement that the purchaser is authorized by 24.2-405/406, will use the lists only for the prescribed purposes, and will not permit use or copying by unauthorized persons, subject to felony penalties (Va. Code 24.2-407).

sources.cite: Va. Code 24.2-407 (purchaser statement: authorized person, authorized use, no copying by unauthorized persons)
Va. Code 24.2-406 (lists of persons who voted; restricted recipients)

private_challenge.who: Any three qualified voters of the county or city (Va. Code 24.2-431(A)).
private_challenge.form_or_statute: Va. Code 24.2-431: petition to the circuit court objecting to a person's registration; 15 days' notice to the person unless the court orders otherwise; the court decides summarily. Amended by Acts 2026, c. 1064. A petition based only on removal of residence from the precinct is not allowed.
private_challenge.deadlines: No deadline in 24.2-431; the order is not limited by the registration-closing rule in 24.2-416. Appeal within 7 days.

sources.cite: Va. Code 24.2-427 (cancellation; notice and 14 days for non-citizen reports)

county_board.name: Virginia Department of Elections - local general registrar and electoral board contacts

ag.name: Office of the Attorney General of Virginia

audit_path.statute: Va. Code 2.2-3704 (Virginia Freedom of Information Act) and 52 U.S.C. 20507(i) (NVRA public inspection of list-maintenance records)
audit_path.what_you_can_request: Counts only, from the general registrar or the Department of Elections: per year, the number of registrants reported as non-citizens through the DMV lists (24.2-410.1) or SAVE, the number of notices mailed under 24.2-427(B), and the number of registrations cancelled after 14 days without a sworn citizenship statement.
audit_path.note: Do not ask for names. The DMV lists are confidential and for official use only (24.2-410.1). No Virginia statute sends juror citizenship answers to election officials, so there is no jury count to ask for.

gates.basis: Jury records: no Virginia statute opens or closes records of non-citizen disqualifications (null), and a private citizen cannot lawfully obtain the voter list (Va. Code 24.2-405). Strict gates: counts only.

notes: RE-VERIFIED 2026-10-09 (review/VA.reverify-2026-10-09.md): 8.01-337, 8.01-353, 24.2-405, 24.2-410.1, 24.2-427, 24.2-431 read on law.lis.virginia.gov. New since 2026-10-07: 24.2-427 now shows three versions (current; and two effective Jan 1, 2027 depending on a contingency in Acts 2026, cc. 992 and 1081, cl. 3). The non-citizen notice text (14 days) is the same in all three. No gate change.

CHANGED 2026-10-07: applied under Optimus standing rule (no gate loosens). jury_list statute quoted exactly (8.01-337, 8.01-353(A)); jury sources; audit_path; federal_source_url moved to govinfo. jury_list.public stays null. official_pipeline set to null (ruled 2026-10-07, REQ-NOTE 49 closed; the DMV/SAVE text moved to notes). No voter_file value changes. 2026-10-07 (Optimus final rulings, REQ-NOTE 65): voter_file.use_restriction added with the exact statutory text (filled from the statute); the app shows it and requires the user's attestation before the voter file loads.

official_pipeline is null (ruled 2026-10-07, REQ-NOTE 49 closed). No Virginia statute sends juror non-citizen information to general registrars or the Department of Elections. Chapter 11 of title 8.01 (8.01-336 to 8.01-363) was searched; registrars appear only as an exemption from jury service. 24.2-404 names only 'reports from the Department of Motor Vehicles pursuant to § 24.2-410.1 or from the Department of Elections based on information received from the Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements Program (SAVE Program)' as non-citizen sources. Under REQ-25 the A.5 letter has no pipeline quote and no 'is this process running' line for VA; it asks only the audit_path counts (DMV lists, SAVE, 24.2-427(B) notices and cancellations).

Non-jury route (moved from official_pipeline 2026-10-07): the official non-citizen route is the DMV list (Va. Code 24.2-410.1, confidential, official use only) and SAVE checks; the general registrar 'shall mail notice promptly to all persons listed in the report as not being a citizen of the United States prior to cancelling' and cancels if no sworn citizenship statement arrives 'within 14 days' (Va. Code 24.2-427(B)).
PA-style check: chapter 11 has no public list of disqualified persons. 8.01-353(A) gives the panel only to counsel of record in the case.

Important: a private person is not an authorized recipient of Virginia voter lists (24.2-405). A user who holds a Virginia list must have obtained it under one of the listed purposes, and JuryRoll matching is not one of them. The app should warn Virginia users before loading a voter file.
Cancelled-voter file: no published Virginia cancelled-voter file with a jury reason code was found. REQ-NOTE 27 drops cancelled rows before matching.
Acts 2026, c. 1064 repealed 24.2-432 and 24.2-651 (poll challenges) effective July 1, 2026, and amended 24.2-431.
24.2-410.1 has a version effective July 1, 2027. Re-verify before then.
